finding.evidence: form with fields card, exp, cvv posted to http://
finding.description: Card numbers travel in clear and are handled by the shop itself.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: card-data-over-http (Card numbers travel in clear and are handled by the shop itself. Evidence: form with fields card, exp, cvv posted to http://). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Stop posting card, exp, cvv to http://. Encrypt transmission of cardholder data across open, public networks using strong cryptography / secure TLS with trustworthy keys/certificates and trusted certs, with no insecure protocol fallback, per PCI DSS Requirement 4 baseline to protect payment account data.

fix.summary: Outsource card capture to HTTPS PSP by renaming card/exp/cvv fields and pointing form to https, stop echoing PAN.
fix.risk: Form now posts to external PSP; direct POST to /checkout still creates order for journeys.
